description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding {C}{C}.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding {C}{C}.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Repeat.
